subject.title: fix(media): bound ffmpeg conversion wait with a timeout

question: Should receive-side attachment conversion intentionally fall back to the original metadata after 60 seconds, or should this PR use and validate a more conservative internal deadline?
rationale: The implementation fixes the indefinite wait, but the exact production cutoff changes previously unbounded successful behavior and cannot be selected from the short conversion and hung-process proof alone.

options.title: Raise and validate the deadline
options.body: Choose a more conservative internal bound and add representative large or slow conversion proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the 60-second fallback
options.body: Merge the current default while explicitly accepting that unusually slow conversions will return unconverted attachment metadata.

recommendation.title: Raise and validate the deadline
recommendation.body: Choose a more conservative internal bound and add representative large or slow conversion proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the conversion lifecycle whose compatibility policy is changing.
